annotations.title: Make a link that opens a routine in the app

description: Checks a routine written in the form how_to_write_a_routine describes and returns a link. Opened on an iPhone with Routine Run, it shows the routine on the app's review screen, where the person saves it or not. Nothing is kept here. Give the person the link and the JSON too, in case the link is opened somewhere else.

routine.description: The routine: one JSON object in the form, with "routineRun": 1, a name and its steps. JSON text is read too.

name: routine_link
